messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — p99 latency > 2.5s for streaming responses across us-west-2 for the last 4m. SLOs breached. auto-ticket #INC-2435 created.

ops-bot: service: streaming-runtime, symptom: tail stalls, metric: p95=1.1s p99=2.8s error-rate=0.7% prefix-cache-hitrate=12%

sarah (oncall): ack. I'm on it. pulling traces and recent deploys. @kai @nora can you join?

kai: on my way, checking alerts and Redis/kvcache dashboards now.

nora: looking at streaming traces — lots of stalled frames around token 40-80, retries hitting fallback which increases latency.

sarah (oncall): any recent changes to prefixhash / cache rollout?

kai: we rolled prefix-hash-v2 to 30% at 03:08 (canary). commit: `deploy/prefixhash:v2 @ 2026-03-15T03:08Z`

ash_pm: FYI noticed slightly lower hit rates in staging earlier today during canary tests but it didn't trip alerts.

julian (support): we have an incoming VIP ticket from a customer saying streaming responses are often delayed/partial. preparing to escalate if we can't stabilize.

sarah (oncall): metrics snapshot ->
- overall hitrate: 12% (baseline 78%)
- p95 streaming: 1.12s -> baseline 0.35s
- p99 streaming: 2.82s -> baseline 0.9s
- error retries increased x3

kai: logs show cache keys changed shape after the rollout. Many prefix keys now map to different buckets -> high miss amplification. sample key diff: `prefix:v1:hash(abc...) != prefix:v2:hash(abc...)`

nora: that explains low hitrate and cold fetches into paging layer + downstream burst to origin which causes queuing and tail stalls.

sarah (oncall): initial mitigations: 1) pause rollout 2) route traffic off canary pool -> older prefixhash 3) enable aggressive prefetch warmup on hot prefixes 4) notify customers. I'll run 1+2 now.

kai: paused rollout at 03:19Z (api call: `POST /deploys/pause prefixhash:v2`). verifying traffic split...

ops-bot: Deploy pause confirmed. traffic now 100% -> prefixhash-v1 on canary pool.

nora: after pause, hitrate recovered from 12% -> 58% in ~90s. p95 down to 0.6s, p99 to 1.1s. still above baseline but trending down.

sarah (oncall): good. next: warmup hot prefixes for the impacted pools. @kai can you run prefetch job for top 200 keys? use low-priority background workers so we don't overload origin.

kai: launching prefetch job: `./tools/prefetch --top-k 200 --pool canary --rate-limit 200r/s` starting now. will monitor queue.

julian (support): telling the affected customer that we're investigating and that we paused the canary and expect stabilization in ~5-10m. keeping them updated.

ash_pm: any risk to rollback? is pause enough or do we need a full rollback?

nora: pause restored majority of hits. full rollback not required yet, but we should not resume rollout until we patch hashing compatibility or add migration mapping.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefixcache-migration (ref: steps for pause, warmup, rollback)

sarah (oncall): adding short mitigation summary for handoff: paused prefixhash-v2 canary at 03:19Z, routed traffic to v1, launched prefetch job, observed hitrate recovery 12% -> 58% and p99 improvement 2.8s -> 1.1s. customer notified.

kai: also added temporary fallback route in routing table for streaming-runtime to divert to backup shard pool if latency > 1.5s for 3 consecutive seconds. config snippet:
```json
{"route":"/stream","fallback_pool":"streaming-legacy","threshold_ms":1500}
```

nora: monitoring traces to confirm no more token stalls. so far tail error retries dropping.

julian (support): customer acknowledges stabilization, asked for postmortem and timeline. adding them to follow-up list.

sarah (oncall): note for postmortem: root cause = prefix hash variant mismatch created remapped cache keyspace; migration lacked sticky aliasing + pre-warm strategy. action items: (A) add compatibility mapping & migration tool, (B) add hitrate smoke tests on canary, (C) add automated rollback trigger when cache-hitrate drops >30% within 5m of rollout.

ash_pm: capturing those in JIRA: RED-INC-2435-POC. assigning to eng-runtime for fix.

ops-bot: ALERT cleared for p99 latency after 12m. final metrics: p95=0.38s p99=0.95s cache-hit=76% error-rate=0.2%

sarah (oncall): ok prepping handoff. next oncall: @nora you're up. tl;dr: paused prefixhash-v2 canary, warmup and fallback in place, customer notified, monitor for 1h. see runbook link above.

nora: ack, I'll take it and keep an eye for regression windows. I have the prefetch job logs and can extend warmup if needed.

julian (support): I'll prepare a short customer-facing summary and link the postmortem when ready.

sarah (oncall): done handoff. tagging thread with `#postmortem-needed` and adding timeline to incident ticket. closing active page. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Handoff recorded: incident owner=sarah (oncall), next_oncall=nora, duration=44m, incident_ticket=INC-2435

nora: adding 1 hour monitoring task. leaving this thread for async updates. anyone else?

ash_pm: thanks team. follow-up doc owner = kai for the migration tool.

julian (support): thanks — will update the customer with final ETA for PM follow-up.

sarah (oncall): good work everyone. off to update the incident channel with summary. :thumbsup:
